cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Work with the AI/ML Platform Enablement team within the eCommerce Analytics team. The broader team is currently on a transformation path, and this role will be instrumental in enabling the broader team's vision.
Work closely with other Data Scientists to help with production models and maintain them in production.
Deploy and configure Kubernetes components for production cluster, including API Gateway, Ingress, Model Serving, Logging, Monitoring, Cron Jobs, etc. Improve the model deployment process for MLE for faster builds and simplified workflows.
Be a technical leader on various projects across platforms and a hands-on contributor of the entire platform's architecture.
Responsible for leading operational excellence initiatives in the AI/ML space which includes efficient use of resources, identifying optimization opportunities, forecasting capacity, etc.
Design and implement different flavors of architecture to deliver better system performance and resiliency.
Develop capability requirements and transition plan for the next generation of AI/ML enablement technology, tools, and processes to enable efficient performance improvement at scale.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Total IT experience: 10+ years
Python: 6+ years
PySpark: 6+ years
PyTorch: 6+ years
Docker: 4+ years
KubeFlow: 4+ years
Google Cloud Platform: 3+ years
Web development: 3+ years
6+ Years relevant experience in roles with responsibility over data platforms and data operations dealing with large volumes of data in cloud-based distributed computing environments
Ability to transform designs ground up and lead innovation in system design
Deep understanding of GenAI applications and NLP field
Hands-on experience in the design and development of NLP models
Experience in building LLM-based applications
Design and development of MLOps pipelines
Fundamental understanding of data science parameterized and non-parameterized algorithms
Knowledge of AI/ML application lifecycles and workflows
Experience in the design and development of an ML pipeline using containerized components
Have worked on at least one Kubernetes cloud offering (EKS/GKE/AKS) or on-prem Kubernetes (native Kubernetes, Gravity, MetalK8s)
Programming experience in Python, PySpark, PyTorch, Langchain, Docker, KubeFlow
Proven ability to solve enterprise-level data operations problems at scale which require cross-functional collaboration for solution development, implementation, and adoption
Preferred Requirements:
Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., computer engineering, computer science, economics, math, operations research)
Ability to use observability tools (Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana) to look at logs and metrics to diagnose issues within the system
Experience with Web development

cond_0351.intro: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team, working alongside the AI/ML Platform Enablement team within the eCommerce Analytics team. The broader team is on a transformation path, and this role will help support and advance that shared vision.
cond_0351.responsibilities:
Coordinate closely with other Data Scientists to support production models and help maintain them in production.
Work alongside the team to deploy and configure Kubernetes components for the production cluster, including API Gateway, Ingress, Model Serving, Logging, Monitoring, Cron Jobs, etc. Collaborate to improve the model deployment process for faster builds and simplified workflows.
Contribute as a hands-on technical resource across various projects, sharing in the architecture decisions across platforms.
Partner with the team on operational excellence initiatives in the AI/ML space, including efficient use of resources, identifying optimization opportunities, and forecasting capacity.
Collaborate on the design and implementation of different architecture approaches to deliver better system performance and resiliency.
Work with stakeholders to develop capability requirements and transition plans for the next generation of AI/ML enablement technology, tools, and processes, helping the organization improve performance at scale.
cond_0351.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
6+ Years of relevant experience in roles with responsibility over data platforms and data operations dealing with large volumes of data in cloud-based distributed computing environments.
Python 6+ years of experience.
PySpark 6+ years of experience.
PyTorch 6+ years of experience.
Docker 4+ years of experience.
KubeFlow 4+ years of experience.
Google Cloud Platform 3+ years of experience.
Web development 3+ years of experience.
Hands-on experience in the design and development of NLP models.
Experience building LLM-based applications.
Experience in the design and development of an ML pipeline using containerized components.
Have worked on at least one Kubernetes cloud offering (EKS/GKE/AKS) or on-prem Kubernetes (native Kubernetes, Gravity, MetalK8s).
Programming experience in Python, PySpark, PyTorch, Langchain, Docker, and KubeFlow.
Knowledge of AI/ML application lifecycles and workflows.
Fundamental understanding of data science parameterized and non-parameterized algorithms.
Proven ability to solve enterprise-level data operations problems at scale requiring cross-functional collaboration for solution development, implementation, and adoption.
Preferred Requirements:
Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., computer engineering, computer science, economics, math, operations research).
Deep understanding of GenAI applications and the NLP field.
Experience with design and development of MLOps pipelines.
Ability to use observability tools (Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana) to review logs and metrics and diagnose system issues.
Ability to transform designs from the ground up and contribute to innovation in system design.

Work with the AI/ML Platform Enablement team within the eCommerce Analytics team. The broader team is currently on a transformation path, and this role will be instrumental in enabling the broader team's vision.
Work closely with other Data Scientists to help with production models and maintain them in production.
Deploy and configure Kubernetes components for production cluster, including API Gateway, Ingress, Model Serving, Logging, Monitoring, Cron Jobs, etc. Improve the model deployment process for MLE for faster builds and simplified workflows.
Be a technical leader on various projects across platforms and a hands-on contributor of the entire platform's architecture.
Responsible for leading operational excellence initiatives in the AI/ML space which includes efficient use of resources, identifying optimization opportunities, forecasting capacity, etc.
Design and implement different flavors of architecture to deliver better system performance and resiliency.
Develop capability requirements and transition plan for the next generation of AI/ML enablement technology, tools, and processes to enable efficient performance improvement at scale.
cond_0578.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 10 years of total IT experience.
6+ Years of demonstrated expertise in roles with direct responsibility over data platforms and data operations, handling large volumes of data in cloud-based distributed computing environments.
Deep expertise in Python, PySpark, and PyTorch (6+ years each).
Strong command of Docker and KubeFlow (4+ years each).
Proven track record in the design and development of NLP models and GenAI applications.
Advanced knowledge of MLOps pipelines, including design and development.
Extensive experience building LLM-based applications.
Solid expertise in designing and developing ML pipelines using containerized components.
Demonstrated experience with at least one Kubernetes cloud offering (EKS/GKE/AKS) or on-prem Kubernetes (native Kubernetes, Gravity, MetalK8s).
Proficiency in observability tools (Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana) for log and metrics analysis and issue diagnosis.
Proven ability to solve enterprise-level data operations problems at scale, requiring cross-functional collaboration for solution development, implementation, and adoption.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., computer engineering, computer science, economics, math, operations research) required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial expertise in Google Cloud Platform (3+ years).
Significant prior experience in web development (3+ years).
Advanced knowledge of AI/ML application lifecycles and workflows.
Deep understanding of data science parameterized and non-parameterized algorithms.
Expertise in Langchain.
Exceptional ability to transform designs from the ground up and lead innovation in system design.
